The '''Highland Trail''' was a roadway that ran through the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], starting at the [[Juran Crossroads]] at the southwestern corner of the [[House Alde (estate)|House Alde estate]] and running north up the [[Juran Pass]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Highland Trail is an area on Alderaan in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
